detail: TIME defines clk/csb/web inputs; clk_buf/clk_bar/cs/we/gated_clk/wl_en/rbl_delay/s_en/w_en/PRE outputs and internal DFF/delay-chain logic.
TIME subcircuit contains logic/transistor-level instances and no independent voltage source definitions.
create_testbench() instantiates TIME from the testbench flow, then decoder/wordline/read/write periphery consume TIME outputs.
Repository positions OpenYield as an SRAM circuit generator and simulation / yield-analysis platform.
readme_compiler.md describes time_generate.py as clock, delay chain, flip-flop, and control timing generation inside the test platform.
Git history shows TIME and testbench evolving together in simulation-oriented commits, but does not state physical-macro implementation intent.
